C9000106.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 106 (Hardness of coloring three-colorable graphs.; papers: Hardness of finding large independent sets in three-colorable graphs; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/106.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

A_ALIGNMENT.statement: For every s,d>=1 and eta>0, one finite rational sampler, chosen before the label universe and all separated bounded lists, has alignment probability at least 1-eta.

A_PATTERNS.statement: Finite equality patterns eliminate dependence on the label universe while preserving separation and badness.

A_MINIMAX.statement: Finite minimax converts failure of every real sampler into random allowed patterns making every s-set bad with probability at least xi>0.

A_HOMOGENIZATION.statement: Ramsey extraction, finite-simplex compactness, and countable extension yield consistent order-invariant laws on Q retaining the badness lower bound.

A_INVARIANT_CUT.statement: Every occupied equivalence class in an order-invariant separated rational-index pattern almost surely has a common index.

A_RATIONALIZATION.statement: A strict tolerance margin allows rational approximation uniformly over all badness indicators on the fixed finite outcome set.

A_THREE_UPPER.statement: For s=3, at most d middle indices between pinned endpoints are bad; the resulting rational sampler is chosen before all label universes and list families.

A_THREE_SHARP.statement: For s=3,r>=3,d>=1, the exact finite minimax failure value is min(1,d/(r-2)); the lower-bound proof is prose, not Lean.

A_UNIFORM4_EXCLUSION.statement: Uniform sampling on four-sets fails with probability at least 3/8 on an explicit separated size-1 list family for every r>=4; this excludes only the uniform-law route.
